consent.title: Let's review your document and selfie
consent.intro: {agency} requested this verification for {reference}. It takes about 3 minutes.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: The photos you confirm and send, including retakes and images rejected during analysis, form the evidence history. Photos discarded before sending stay only in your browser. We do not record video or audio.

purpose.title: Why
purpose.body: To support the agency's review of the document holder and their interest in the property.

retention.title: How long
retention.body: Images are deleted when validation is completed or, if manual review is required, within 7 days.

consent.pilotNotice: The document, selfie and movements help the team review your request. A person makes the final decision.
consent.checkbox: I have read and agree to the use of my image and document for this verification.
consent.alternative: I cannot or do not want to use the camera
consent.privacyBody: Your images will be used only for this verification, with restricted access and no public disclosure. They will be deleted when validation is completed or, if manual review is required, within 7 days.

camera.title: Now let's use the camera
camera.body: When you select Enable camera, allow access in your computer or phone browser. We only use the camera, without audio, and turn it off when you leave this step.

tips.light: A well-lit place, without strong light behind you
tips.original: Have your original document ready, not a copy

document.rgFrontHint: For an RG, start with the side showing the holder's photo. Include the entire document with all edges visible.
document.rgBackHint: Now turn the RG over and photograph the opposite side to the one you captured first.

documentReview.beforeSending: Your photos have not been sent. Confirm to continue with the selfie and movements; submission happens after the final review.
documentReview.title: Can you read everything?
documentReview.body: Check that the name, number and photo are visible without glare or cropping.

titles.position: Fit your face inside the oval
titles.turnLeft: Turn your face to the left
titles.turnRight: Turn your face to the right
titles.closer: Bring your face closer to the camera

hints.position: Fit your face inside the oval.
hints.turnLeft: Turn your face to your left
hints.turnRight: Turn your face to your right
hints.closer: Move your face a little closer to the camera.

framing.checking: Fit your face inside the oval.
framing.notFound: We cannot see your face. Look at the camera and fit your face inside the oval.
framing.multipleFaces: More than one person is visible. Stay alone in the frame.
framing.offCenter: Center your face inside the oval.
framing.ready: Your face is well positioned. Hold still and take the selfie.
framing.tooFar: {device, select, mobile {Move your phone a little closer to your face.} other {Move a little closer to the camera.}}
framing.tooClose: {device, select, mobile {Move your phone a little farther from your face.} other {Move a little farther from the camera.}}
framing.unavailable: We could not check the framing. Fit your face inside the oval and take the selfie.
framing.closer: {device, select, mobile {Bring your phone a little closer to your face.} other {Move your face a little closer to the camera.}}

submit.body: Keep this page open. If your connection drops, reopen the same link to continue.

result.closeHint: You can now close this page.

approved.title: Verification approved by the team
approved.body: The {agency} team reviewed your information and recorded its approval. Contact the agency for the next steps.

review.title: We received your information
review.body: A member of the {agency} team will review your verification. There is nothing else you need to do now.

next.one: The team reviews the photos you sent.
next.two: You receive a response through the channel agreed with the agency.
next.three: If anything is missing, the team will send a new link.

rejected.title: Verification closed
rejected.body: {agency} will contact you with the next steps.

expired.title: This link is no longer active
expired.body: Ask {agency} for a new verification link.

redo.title: Let's take the photo again

reasons.documentIllegible: The document photo was hard to read. This can happen because of glare or low light.
reasons.selfieQuality: We could not see your face clearly. Try a brighter place.
reasons.reopenedByAgency: {agency} enabled another attempt. Let's retake the document photos and selfie.
reasons.lowSimilarity: Document and selfie similarity was 10% or less. Retake the document, selfie and movements in good light. If it remains low, a person will review the history.

tips.one: Place the document on a dark, non-reflective table.
tips.two: Stand near a window, without direct light on the document.

redo.human: Request a review by a person

alternative.title: That's okay, there is another way
alternative.body: A member of the agency team can verify your identity without a camera. This may take longer.
alternative.reasonLegend: Tell us why, if you wish

reasons.noCamera: I have no camera or it does not work
reasons.accessibility: I cannot perform the requested movements
reasons.noConsent: I do not want to send biometric data

alternative.sentBody: {agency} will contact you to continue with a person. Photos already submitted remain in the verification history.

live.galleryHint: You can upload the document from your gallery, but the selfie and movements require a camera.
live.noGalleryHint: Allow camera access in your browser or continue without biometrics.
live.documentPortraitHint: Position the entire document upright inside the frame without glare. The saved photo includes only this area.
live.documentHint: Fit the entire document inside the frame without glare. The saved photo includes only this area.
live.selfieBackgroundHint: Take your selfie against a plain background, without pictures or writing.
live.reviewBeforeSending: Capture both sides. You can review and retake the photos before sending them.
live.selfieReviewHint: Check that your whole face is clear. This photo stays in your browser until the final review.
live.captureFailed: We could not use this photo. Try again.

issues.unreadable: We could not open this image. Take the photo again.
issues.lowResolution: The photo resolution is too low. Move the camera closer and try again.
issues.documentFaceNotFound: We could not find a face on the document. Photograph the side with your photo, fully visible and without glare.
issues.looksLikeSelfie: This does not look like a document. Photograph the full document on a flat surface.
issues.selfieFaceNotFound: We could not find your face. Look at the camera in a well-lit place.
issues.multipleFaces: More than one person appeared. Take the selfie alone.
issues.faceTooSmall: Your face looks too small. Move closer to the camera and fit your face inside the oval.
issues.tooDark: The photo is too dark. Move to a brighter place.
issues.tooBright: The photo is too bright. Avoid strong light or direct glare.
issues.blurry: The photo is blurry or out of focus. Hold still and try again.
issues.duplicatePhoto: This photo was used in another step. Take a new photo.
issues.looksLikeDocument: This looks like a document photo. Take a selfie of your face.
issues.documentTextNotFound: We could not read the document. Photograph the full document with its text visible.
issues.livenessFaceNotFound: We could not find your face in one of the photos. Keep your entire face visible and try again.
issues.livenessDifferentPerson: The face changed between photos. Perform the movements alone and try again.
issues.livenessNotTurned: We did not detect the requested movement. Turn your face a little further and try again.
issues.livenessExpired: The movement window expired. Start capturing again to continue from the pending step.
issues.livenessIncomplete: Some movements are still pending. Start capturing again to continue.
issues.spoofSuspected: This may be a photo of a screen or printout. Take a selfie directly of your face.
issues.livenessNotCloser: We did not detect your face getting closer. Move your face closer to the camera and try again.
issues.livenessSpoofSuspected: One photo may be from a screen or printout. Repeat the movements directly with your face.
issues.livenessOutOfOrder: The sequence needs to be synchronized. Start capturing again; accepted steps will be preserved.
issues.documentShapeNotFound: We could not identify a document shape. Photograph the full document on a flat surface and try again.

live.challengeHint: Read the instructions and adjust your pose at your own pace. Clicking Capture photo starts the 3-second countdown.
live.captured: Photo taken. Review it before continuing.
live.closeEnough: Close enough. Hold still for the photo.
live.notFoundTitle: No camera found on this device
live.notFoundHint: {device, select, computer {If your computer has no webcam, continue this verification on your phone.} other {Open the link directly in your device’s browser and check that camera access is allowed.}}
live.deniedHint: {device, select, computer {Allow camera access in this website’s browser settings and try again. You can also continue on your phone.} other {Allow camera access in this website’s browser settings and try again.}}
live.unavailableHint: {device, select, computer {Close other apps using the camera and try again, or continue on your phone.} other {Close other apps using the camera and try again.}}
live.insecureTitle: Open a secure link to use the camera
live.insecureHint: Open the verification using the HTTPS address sent by the person responsible for the property.
live.unsupportedTitle: This browser cannot access the camera
live.unsupportedHint: {device, select, computer {Open the link in another browser or continue the verification on your phone.} other {Open the link in another browser that allows camera access.}}
live.permissionHint: If your browser asks, allow camera access to continue.
live.nextPoseHint: Review the photo. Click Next to read the instructions for the next pose. The countdown only starts when you click Capture photo.
live.allPosesCaptured: All poses have been captured. Review the photos before sending.

capture.cameraNotice: Your document, selfie and movements will be sent for analysis and review by a member of the agency team.

import.frontTitle: Crop the front of the document
import.backTitle: Crop the back of the document
import.help: Adjust Crop 1 for the front and Crop 2 for the back. Each side keeps its own area and page. Drag on the image or adjust the percentages. Photos stay in your browser until the final review.
import.fileSize: Choose a file up to 20 MB.
import.pageLimit: Choose a PDF with up to 20 pages.
import.password: This PDF is password-protected. Upload a copy without a password.
import.invalid: We could not open this file. Try another PDF or a JPG or PNG image.
import.detectionFailed: We could not suggest a crop. Adjust the area manually; analysis is still required when submitting.
import.detected: We suggested an area for this side. Check the crop and adjust before sending.
import.noRegions: Select the document area. The crop stays in your browser until final submission.
import.frontFirst: You can adjust the back now. Send the front before sending the back.
import.preview: Document page with selected crop area

phone.title: Continue verification on your phone
phone.instructions: Scan the QR code with your phone camera, or copy and open the link in its browser. Then allow camera access to complete the verification.
phone.qrLabel: QR code to open this verification on your phone
phone.privateLink: This link is personal. Use it only on your own device and do not share it with other people.
phone.unreachable: This address cannot be used on your phone. Ask the person responsible for the property for an HTTPS link that your device can access.
phone.copyFailed: Unable to copy automatically. Select the address above and copy it manually.

review.title: Review before sending
review.body: Check the document photos, selfie and movements. Nothing has been sent for validation. Send when you are happy with the captures.
review.resumeBody: Some photos have already been sent. You can resume validation or retake a capture.
review.failedPhoto: Could not validate: {photo}. Check the guidance and retake the capture if needed.

reviewReasons.experimentalMatch: Experimental analysis: a person always decides
reviewReasons.faceNotFound: Face not found in the document or selfie
reviewReasons.lowSimilarityRepeated: Similarity at or below 10% after a new attempt
reviewReasons.documentManualReview: Document accepted after three rejected photos: manual review required

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Last 7 days
overview.pilotWarning: Analysis supports the review of evidence. Approval requires a human decision by the agency team.

decisionTime.label: Time to decision
decisionTime.caption: median time from submission to decision

chart.title: Sessions completed per day

newVerification.dataMinimization: Select the property for this request. CPF is optional and is used to check the document.

passiveLiveness.help: likelihood of a real face rather than a screen or photo (uncalibrated MiniFASNet)

signals.policy: Similarity is not a probability of identity. The ranges guide retakes and review; final approval requires a team member.

decision.title: Decision

reject.confirm: Reject the verification for {name}? The decision is recorded in the audit log.

decision.autoApproved: Approval recorded by the agency team.
decision.notReady: A decision can be recorded when the session is in review.

reopen.help: If rejection was a mistake or another attempt is appropriate, the person can retry ({attemptsLeft} attempts left).
reopen.confirm: Allow another attempt for {name}? The rejection will no longer apply and the person can retake the photos.

manualOverride.reviewed: I reviewed the available evidence and accept responsibility for this manual approval.

alerts.manyRejectedPhotos: Several photos were rejected during upload. Review carefully.
alerts.documentManualReview: Capture continued after three photos of one document side were rejected. Review all three images in the evidence; manual review is required.
alerts.possibleSpoof: The selfie or a movement photo may have come from a screen or printed photo. Review the images.
alerts.documentShapeNotFound: No document shape (RG, CNH or CIN) was found in the photos.

alerts.lowSimilarityRepeated: Similarity remained low (10% or less). Review the photos from each attempt before deciding.
alerts.lowSimilarity: Similarity is 10% or less and no attempts remain. Review the photos before deciding.
